svg.text: Repaso — a parent's first week, message by message
The whole product lives in one Telegram chat that belongs to the parent. The child installs nothing, has no account, and has no real name — only an alias.
Two moments ask the parent to decide. Everything else the system settles on its own, or refuses to send.

g.text: DAY 0 · SIGN-UP
≈ 8 minutes, once
Hola, soy Repaso, el tutor de refuerzo de tu familia.
Yo trabajo contigo, el representante: tú me mandas el
material y yo armo una práctica corta cada día.
Antes de empezar, lo importante:
1. La cuenta es tuya. Tu hijo o hija nunca usa Telegram.
2. Nunca me des el nombre real. Usaremos un alias.
3. Guardo solo alias, grado, material y respuestas.
4. Código abierto; tus datos no. /forget borra todo.
¿Aceptas estas condiciones?
Acepto
No acepto
Acepto
¿Qué alias usamos para el estudiante?
Leo
three more questions, one short answer each —
grade 4 · San José 4to B · practice at 7:00 pm
Leo queda inscrito. Cada día a las 7pm llega una
práctica de 5 a 10 minutos a este chat. Solo te
interrumpo aparte cuando haya una decisión que tomar.
Four facts, and not one of them is a name: an alias, a grade, a section and an hour.
The strict data models physically reject anything shaped like a real identity, and
/forget erases every trace of the family after a double confirmation.
DAY 0 · FIRST MATERIAL
whatever the school already sent
cuaderno_leo.jpg · 2.1 MB
Recibido ✔ Estoy preparando el material.
THE INGEST GRAPH — THE PARENT NEVER SEES IT
Armor screener → material parser → competency mapper
→ item generator → item critic → answerability probe
Material listo: preparé 7 ejercicios sobre
fracciones equivalentes.
…and when the material will not do, it says so instead of inventing:
La foto salió borrosa y no quiero inventar lo que no
leo. ¿Puedes tomarla de nuevo con más luz? Si puedes,
envíala como archivo para que no pierda calidad.
Con esto solo conozco el tema, pero no cómo lo trabajan
en clase. ¿Me mandas una foto de un ejercicio resuelto?
Ese material no parece de matemática. Si crees que me
equivoqué, reenvíalo con una nota corta del tema.
A deterministic legibility metric gates the OCR and the Armor screener runs before
any model call: 400/400 adversarial payloads intercepted across 9 families, ES and
EN, at 0 % false-block on 200 clean grade-4 texts. Garbage is never made into practice.
DAY 1 … n · THE DAILY CAPSULE
7:00 pm, every day
— today, 7:00 pm —
Práctica de hoy para Leo — Fracciones equivalentes
Dos fracciones son equivalentes si representan la misma
parte del entero: 2/4 y 1/2 son la misma cantidad.
1 · REVIEW — DUE TODAY (SM-2)
¿Cuál fracción equivale a 2/4?
¡Correcto! 2/4 y 1/2 cubren la misma parte del entero.
2 · review — Recta numérica y décimas ✔ correcto
3 · NEW — ONE NEW THING EVERY DAY
Compara 3/5 y 2/3. ¿Cuál es mayor?
Todavía no. Llévalas al mismo denominador: 9/15 y 10/15.
¡Práctica de hoy completa! Racha de 4 días. Hasta mañana.
THE DETERMINISTIC HALF OF THIS PANEL
SM-2 picks what is due · mastery is an EMA over graded
attempts · difficulty follows measured performance, not mood.
Reviews come first, and one unseen item keeps a reserved slot every day so a strong
student still meets new material. Feedback is immediate — nothing in this panel waits
for a human. 420 student-days produced 1,062 graded responses in about 14 seconds.
YOU DECIDE — 1 of 2
low-confidence open answer
Necesito tu ojo: Leo respondió «creo que es un medio,
más o menos» y no estoy seguro de cómo calificarla.
¿La das por buena?
Está bien
Está mal
Está bien
MEANWHILE, IN THE DETERMINISTIC HARNESS
grader confidence 0.30 < gate 0.85 → the grade
does NOT exist; the answer sits in quarantine.
AND WHAT YOUR TAP BECOMES
a human label: your verdict, the machine's verdict, the
confidence it had, and how long you took to decide.
The system never guesses. Below the 0.85 confidence gate no grade exists until a
human decides. One tap, no typing, no app — and the child's exact words are shown
to you verbatim, never paraphrased and never guessed at.
YOU DECIDE — 2 of 2
sustained, measured struggle
Leo lleva varios días tropezando con fracciones
equivalentes. Esta es la evidencia: 3 aciertos de 11
intentos en 6 días de clase, y el repaso de ayer
también falló. ¿Qué prefieres?
Sesión guiada de 10 min juntos esta noche (te la preparo)
costs ten minutes of yours tonight · the session is already built
Nota para la maestra (ya está redactada, tú decides enviarla)
leaves the family chat · carries counts, never names or aliases
Bajar el ritmo y consolidar el tema anterior
moves slower · changes the order, never the rigour
WHAT HAD TO HAPPEN BEFORE THIS MESSAGE EXISTED
≥ 9 attempts of evidence (a slab-validated plateau centre) ·
once per 7-day cooldown · a model opinion cannot veto or force it.
Precision 0.970 [0.947–0.983], recall 0.994 [0.980–0.998] on 40 virgin seeds —
16,800 simulated student-days, against a rate-matched random baseline of 0.300.
Three options, each with its cost stated. The system does not choose for you.
SUNDAY · WEEKLY DIGEST
no decision required
Resumen semanal de Leo: 6 prácticas, 78 % de aciertos,
racha de 5 días. Dominio por tema: 4 dominados ·
3 en camino · 1 difícil.
Aviso: 3 familias de San José 4to B están tropezando
con fracciones equivalentes esta semana. Redacté una
nota para la maestra por si quieres compartirla:
Enviar a la maestra
No, gracias
K-ANONYMOUS — NOT AN ORDINARY NOTIFICATION
≥ 3 distinct families, same section and competency ·
once per ISO week · the note-drafting prompt never receives
an alias, and the note carries counts, never names.
The teacher installs nothing and has no account: the value reaches the classroom
through the parent, who decides whether the note is sent at all. A judge gets the
same story from the other side — a read-only web mirror behind an access code.
And the moments you are NOT interrupted — half the product
A wrong answer
The child gets the correction instantly. Nothing reaches you.
A bad day, or two
The trigger needs ≥ 9 attempts of evidence before it can exist.
A topic you were told about 5 days ago
7-day cooldown per student after each resolution.
Weekend, Carnaval, Semana Santa
0 false disengagement alerts per 100 student-weeks, 20/20 seeds —
the pre-fix build fired 1,689 alerts on the same twenty seeds.
A platform outage
The delivery-health gate masks a day the whole cohort went silent:
everyone quiet at once ≠ one child who quit. 566 → 0 false alerts.
A prompt injection hidden in the material
400/400 adversarial payloads intercepted across 9 families, ES + EN,
before any model call. The family never hears about it.

svg.text: Every bubble is the real Spanish copy from src/repaso/i18n/es.py — 100 % of what the family sees is in Spanish (EN available with /language). The student never installs anything, never has an account, and is known only by an alias.
